question: Does STRATA_MMVQ_WV2_GROUP show a whole-model decode gain? Its isolated microbenchmark measured -24.8% on the wave kernel (nc=5, 300 calls) with bit-identical output.
harness: Suite longgen32: 32K prefill followed by 128 generated tokens, engine decoder timing. Arms in on/off/on(/off) order on the same card across two batches, 8 samples with the switch and 6 without; all arms also carry STRATA_MMVQ_WV2_LDS=1 and STRATA_DECODE_TIMING=1. Output tokens bit-identical in every arm (97e6833014e9deab).
conclusion: The whole-model decode effect is inside the sample drift (samples within one arm differ by about 5%), so the component-level gain does not reproduce end to end. The switch stays enabled because it is bit-identical, but no whole-model gain is claimed for it.
